detail.title: Metabolic and Systemic Modulations of Neurological Function
detail.summary: Analyses of metabolic and neuro-psychiatric interfaces, focusing on how systemic biochemical errors present as cognitive or psychiatric disorders.
detail.reason: To synthesize the available metabolic-neurology evidence as a provisional baseline while noting thyroid-specific gaps.
